name: seo-strategy-roadmap
summary: Sequence approved SEO research, audits, clusters, and business priorities into a source-labeled strategy roadmap with owners, dependencies, and verification.
inputs: business goal, offer, audience, and user value
approved keyword, SERP-intent, content-audit, and topic-cluster artifacts
writes: Home.md review link when review is required
approval_gates: external_read: ask before current external/provider reads not covered by approved artifacts
vault_write: save only to a resolved project, client, or prospect context when authorized
external_mutation: copy, code, CMS, publishing, provider configuration, and production changes are out of scope
done_when: business goal, offer, audience, market, language, device, horizon, capacity, and roadmap date are explicit
evidence register preserves source, date, scope, label, freshness, and limits
strategic objectives connect to business and user outcomes without guarantees
initiatives have affected assets, owner, dependencies, effort, priority, review point, and verification method
Now/Next/Later/Recurring sequence is traceable to evidence and decisions
Writing, Development, WordPress, and verification handoffs are explicit
durable artifact uses project/client/prospect routing and review frontmatter
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred with an actionable reason
verification: verify unsupported metrics and assumed client priorities did not drive the roadmap
verify no ranking, traffic, revenue, conversion, or AI-visibility guarantee is made
verify settled business decisions were not silently reprioritized
verify no final copy, code, CMS, publishing, provider, or production mutation occurred
verify changed Markdown/frontmatter and Home review registration when applicable
